parsed.reason: A parenting question, answered with age-grounded advice: night waking is common at 8, and worry or a busy head is often behind it. It gives concrete steps for tonight (a bedtime worry chat, then a calm walk back to bed with no screens) and ends with the appended full-plan offer, which is allowed. It makes no diagnosis and names no medicine. The length is at the edge of the budget but still fine.
